manual_notes: Miconazole inhibited VEGF expression but VEGF was overnormalized to VEGFB.
Growth hormone induced FoxM1 expression in old mouse liver.
D-glucose treatment upregulated renin expression.
Annexin V positivity was an apoptosis assay readout after kinase inhibitor treatment.
PGF2 alpha is a prostaglandin chemical not PGF.
Fenoldopam induced arteritis but the text only describes measuring TGF beta1.
rhGH intervention increased Pxmp4 expression after CTX treatment.
Gut-derived serotonin attenuated lipocalin 2 release.
THR refers to thyroid hormone receptor activity not threonine.
PCC refers to tumor type context not factor IX complex.
Fentanyl stimulated cdk5-mediated phosphorylation signaling.
Magnesium treatment increased IL-4 secretion.
DHA stimulated TRAIL-induced apoptosis with Bak activation.
KPL-1 is a cell line rather than PLEKHB1.
HIF-1 was normalized to SETD2.
Lycopene prevented increased AChE activity.
Calcitriol increased VEGF expression but the specific VEGFB mapping is uncertain.
Wortmannin inhibited LC3 production but LC3 was normalized to MAP1A.
Betaine reduced TNF alpha mRNA but TNF was normalized to EDA.
Forskolin decreased H2AX phosphorylation after ionizing radiation.
SphK1 plasmid increased FGF-2 expression rather than FGF-2 affecting SphK1.
Berberine inhibited OCT3-mediated monoamine uptake.
IL-1RA reduced TLR4 expression.
Mustard seed suppressed TNF alpha mRNA but TNF was normalized to TNFSF18.
Thiorphan was part of a combination that attenuated Caspase-3 cascades.
Amitriptyline treatment was associated with upregulated Sprr1a.
IBMX culture decreased CSN3 mRNA.
Chenodeoxycholic acid activated intestinal bile acid binding protein.
Hydrochloric acid induced TNF alpha release but TNF was normalized to CD70.
Fluoxetine treatment downregulated the 5-HT7 receptor.
IL-4 affected p27 Kip but the subject and object were not the stated edge.
Sucrose was part of the chilling medium associated with decreased sox3 expression.
BP-2 was a chemical abbreviation and antioxidant was not IGFBP2.
Gelatin-mTG substrates increased NPHS1 expression.
Chlorzoxazone was a probe substrate used to evaluate CYP2E1 activity.
Aescin can inhibit or induce CYP1A2 activity.
Urokinase activated Akt and was mapped to AKT1.
Clathrin-dependent endocytosis was a pathway readout not CLTA regulation.
Nitrite decreased COX-2 expression but COX-2 was normalized to MT-CO2.
Mtb refers to Mycobacterium tuberculosis not NCAPG2.
TMP in the text was not dTMP.
ATP strongly activated microglial COX-1.
EDTA was a comparator and MUC1 was normalized to MUC22.
TMP195 increased CCL1 production but the subject was truncated to TMP.
Metformin increased IRF4 expression.
Fluvoxamine downregulated TNF alpha but TNF was normalized to TNFSF12.
PAH refers to pulmonary arterial hypertension not aminohippuric acid.
Tetracycline induced RNAi caused decreased WDR1 protein.
Colchicine treatment slightly reduced MAP-2.
bFGF with forskolin increased SCN5A expression after neural differentiation.
Cisplatin treatment decreased SIRT3 expression.
Saline was a vehicle comparator and Elk-1 was normalized to KCNH4.
Chlorogenic acid elevated ALP but ALP was normalized to NAT10.
CUDC-907 treatment increased E-cadherin expression.
PD0325901 inhibited PPAR gamma phosphorylation.
Molybdate inhibited NaS1 transport but NaS1 was normalized to PSMD2.
Bicuculline co-treatment affected Rgs2 expression.
Collagen-induced arthritis was associated with increased Ahr expression.
DET combination treatment lowered PCNA but the DET normalization is uncertain.
LCM means lactobacilli conditioned medium not lincomycin.
Iron chelator affected TNF-induced NF-kappaB signaling but TNF was not TNFSF9.
myc refers to transformed cells not myricetin.
IBMX inhibited MMP1 expression.
EDTA restored E2F DNA-binding activity but not a specific E2F7 effect.
2-DG decreased LIN28B expression.
SR9011 repressed CCNB1 expression.
Piceatannol inhibited MIP-1 alpha release but MIP-1 was normalized to POLG.
Nicotine-containing vapor increased CD34.
DMSO was a vehicle for DMOG treatment.
Polydatin inhibited glycation products in a serum albumin assay.
SIAH2 downregulation was associated with tamoxifen resistance rather than caused by tamoxifen.
MDA refers to malondialdehyde not tenamfetamine.
Actinomycin D was a drug resisted after Pgp expression increased.
SRC-2 was normalized to FGR and was not directly caused by angiotensin II.
Uric acid downregulated UCP2 but the object was UCP1.
Trichostatin A restored PCDH10 expression.
PRI-724 increased TNF alpha but TNF was normalized to TNFSF13B.
Lactobacillus plantarum elevated glutathione reductase expression.
Serotonin was among mediators that inhibit TRPM8 channel activity.
Olive leaf extract downregulated Pin1.
Colchicine reduced transcobalamin receptor expression.
Roflumilast reduced CCL5 expression.
Com.C attenuated BMP2-induced ALP activity rather than BMP2 itself.
AZD4547 had much reduced inhibition toward FGFR4.
lys refers to a worm gene name and SPG-7 was not caused by lysine.
Solution was a bath condition containing channel blockers.
Sterols can inhibit COX2 expression but the specific soy sterol mapping is broad.
Cisplatin with UV-C downregulated HER2.
Isotretinoin upregulated GATA6.
DMSO was the vehicle for KAT2A inhibitor treatment.
Tamoxifen was used to activate E2F constructs and did not affect the signal.
PTH increased Col1a1 expression.
MDC was not BK-MDA.
TCC with immune complexes induced Lck phosphorylation but the TCC identity is uncertain.
Urea diet reduced ENPP1 expression.
Deltamethrin induced vascular endothelial growth factor but the VEGFB mapping is uncertain.
PGE2 decreased ALP activity but ALP was normalized to PDLIM3.
Gold nanoparticles downregulated STAT5 family signaling.
Soybean oil increased cyclin D1 but the object was CCND3.
APAP treatment decreased Mfn1 expression.
